legacy_exclusion.claim: Legacy windows may be reused for public search because metric sampling and source-only arms are outcome-blind. They cannot serve as a new confirmation panel.

separation_rule: Search and validation are item/source-group disjoint. Practice outcomes are absent. Validation is not a final lockbox; a later confirmation packet must also exclude both partitions.
